# `xxhash64`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
xxhash64(expr1, expr2, ...)
```

Returns a 64-bit hash value of the arguments. Hash seed is 42.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT xxhash64('Spark', array(123), 2);
```

Result:

```text
5602566077635097486
```
